Source slide page 1 (extracted text):
PYTHON FOR COMPUTATIONAL
PROBLEM SOLVING
Structure of Python Programs

 Prof. Sindhu R Pai
PCPS Theory Anchor - 2024
Department of Computer Science and Engineering

Source slide page 2 (extracted text):
PYTHON FOR COMPUTATIONAL PROBLEM SOLVING
 Execution Flow

Program Execution Flow

 • Code is executed line by line from top to bottom


 •  EEachh  statement  executedd    iin  sequence  unlessl
   otherwise specified, like in the case of constructs
    like loops and functions





                                                                                                                                                                   2

Source slide page 3 (extracted text):
PYTHON FOR COMPUTATIONAL PROBLEM SOLVING
Basic Syntax and Formatting

• A case-sensitive language.
       input, INpuT are different


•  Rigidg  format;; not free-form.


•  Indentation is key. Constructs like loops and conditional statements have indentation
  requirements that must be followed


•  The program must start from column 0 (the first column). You can’t have a program
   start from an indented block.                                                                                                           3

Source slide page 4 (extracted text):
PYTHON FOR COMPUTATIONAL PROBLEM SOLVING
Multi-line statements


      •  Ideally there must be only One statement per line.


      • One statement can span across multiple lines

         1. Use Escape character ‘\’ to ignore the EOL

         2. Use ( ) constructs

         3.  Begin and end markers must be the same


      •  Multiple statements in one line separated by a ‘ ; ’


                                                                                                                                                                  3

Source slide page 5 (extracted text):
PYTHON FOR COMPUTATIONAL PROBLEM SOLVING
Comments





     •  Single line comments begin with a # symbol


     •  The documentation string is used for commenting multiple lines which is written
      using a pair of triple " " " " " " quotes or ' ' ' ' ' '





                                                                                                                                                                  3
